ideas.pitch: A Python-based simulation tool implementing the BB84 quantum key distribution protocol with real-time eavesdropping detection and visualization.
ideas.problem_statement: Teams use a simplified BB84 protocol to establish secure communication while solving an applied quantum cryptography challenge.
ideas.title: QKD-Guard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core hands-on BB84 protocol challenge with rigorous error rate calculation and clean Qiskit implementation, matching the technical depth of winning engineering projects.

ideas.pitch: An interceptor dashboard that simulates Man-in-the-Middle eavesdropping on a BB84 quantum channel to demonstrate photon measurement disturbance.
ideas.problem_statement: Teams use a simplified BB84 protocol to establish secure communication while solving an applied quantum cryptography challenge.
ideas.title: QuantumSniffer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates deep understanding of quantum mechanics principles (observer effect) during key exchange, giving judges a clear visual proof of security breaches.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight CLI tool for secure message transmission over simulated quantum channels using dynamically generated BB84 keys.
ideas.problem_statement: Teams use a simplified BB84 protocol to establish secure communication while solving an applied quantum cryptography challenge.
ideas.title: BB84-Net
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the complete pipeline from key generation and sifting to encrypted payload transmission, hitting all requirements of the hands-on challenge.

ideas.pitch: An automated testing suite for evaluating the security vulnerabilities and bit error rates of custom QKD protocol implementations.
ideas.problem_statement: Teams use a simplified BB84 protocol to establish secure communication while solving an applied quantum cryptography challenge.
ideas.title: EntangleAudit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges appreciate robust testing and verification frameworks that prove protocol correctness under simulated noise and eavesdropping conditions.

ideas.pitch: A dashboard for managing, rotating, and visualizing quantum-generated keys from a simulated BB84 channel for secure API communication.
ideas.problem_statement: Teams use a simplified BB84 protocol to establish secure communication while solving an applied quantum cryptography challenge.
ideas.title: QuantumKeyManager
ideas.why_it_could_win: Bridges abstract quantum key distribution protocols with practical cryptography use cases, demonstrating end-to-end applied feasibility.
